principles: Reuse one MemoryFreshnessPack core across all consumers instead of creating parallel memory systems.
Keep memory non-authoritative: useful context, never proof evidence.
Make each M5-M12 row machine-verifiable before claiming full completion.
Prefer deterministic generated baselines and small routine smokes before full release-scale checks.
drivers: User explicitly requested all remaining milestones in documented order until fully complete.
Past failures came from partial parent completion and stale/forgotten memory lessons.
The 1M baseline is required before runtime consumption can be called complete or warn/enforce rollout enabled.

options.name: A: Extend MemoryFreshnessPack consumers plus baseline/health commands in one full-scope story
pros: Full M5-M12 ledger can close atomically
cons: Large story; needs careful checklist and staged tests

options.name: B: Split M5-M12 into child stories immediately
cons: High risk of repeating partial completion unless parent totality gate is actively maintained
User asked this run to complete all remaining milestones

options.name: C: Only document rollout and defer code
cons: Does not satisfy user request or red repro

chosen: A: Extend MemoryFreshnessPack consumers plus baseline/health commands in one full-scope story
rationale: The user asked to continue in the documented order until all remaining milestones are done. Option A best preserves one shared runtime memory contract and lets the DONE gate compare implementation evidence against the full M5-M12 ledger.

preMortem.scenario: Story claims complete after wiring only handoff/story/DONE consumers but skips 1M baseline.
preMortem.trigger: MVP2 smokes pass and operator wants DONE early.
preMortem.consequence: Repeats partial completion failure; runtime memory consumption is overclaimed.
preMortem.mitigation: Milestone ledger includes M9/M10 and DONE requires baseline smoke plus full-profile verifier evidence.

preMortem.scenario: Memory pack text gets consumed as gate evidence.
preMortem.trigger: A developer uses playbook hit as proof of parent roadmap completion or DONE readiness.
preMortem.consequence: False proof boundary and evidence confusion.
preMortem.mitigation: All renderers state authority=non_authoritative gateEvidence=false; tests assert DONE/ParentRollup structured evidence remains source of truth.

preMortem.scenario: 1M baseline pollutes repo or material hash.
preMortem.trigger: Generator defaults to project-local tracked output.
preMortem.consequence: Huge dirty worktree and stale evidence churn.
preMortem.mitigation: Default temp/gitignored runtime output; registry/gitignore/materialHash smoke covers project-local opt-in.

preMortem.scenario: agy becomes primary host in rollout wording.
preMortem.trigger: Host taxonomy drift or quota workaround becomes default.
preMortem.consequence: Violates current host policy and weakens 3x2 expectation.
preMortem.mitigation: M12 smoke asserts Codex+Claude primary and agy fallback only with concrete primary failure signal.
